initialInstrumentation.cause: Unsupported spy on a proxied transaction method, replaced by business model spies. Test instrumentation failures, not five product defects.

limits: Isolated fictitious SQLite with real memberships, DAL and actions; authentication and Next cache are mocked.
No local Next server or container; no real supplier or file storage.
PostgreSQL, browser execution and hosted preview require checks on the implementation candidate.
Date cases cover month/year boundaries and DST; not a hosted load or universal concurrency benchmark.
